name: Yashil Uyim
subtitle: Festival program and updates
promotionalText: Explore Yashil Uyim festival activities, save your favorites and read public announcements. No account needed. Interface and festival content are in Uzbek.
description:
Discover Yashil Uyim, an ecological festival bringing people together around nature and sustainable living. Browse published festival information in one place. The interface and festival content are primarily in Uzbek.

EXPLORE THE FESTIVAL
• Program: see activity times, topics and participants.
• Search: find a topic or participant that interests you.
• Saved activities: bookmark program items on your device.
• Announcements: read festival news and information about upcoming activities.
• Gallery: explore photos and videos from festival gatherings.
• Venue: check the date and address, then open an external map.

No registration or Telegram sign-in is required. The app does not sell tickets or accept payments.

An internet connection retrieves current information. Previously downloaded program and announcement text may remain available offline. Images, videos and external maps may require connectivity.

Saved activities remain on your device and are not linked to an account. The app does not request camera, contacts or precise-location permissions.

Festival details may change, so refresh the information before travelling.
reviewNotes:
Yashil Uyim is a guest-only festival companion. Sign-in is not required and there is no account creation, payment, ticket checkout, advertising or analytics SDK. The interface and festival content are primarily in Uzbek.

Bosh = Home; Dastur = Program; Yangiliklar = News; Galereya = Gallery; Manzil = Venue. In Dastur, search activities and tap a bookmark to save it locally; Saqlangan shows saved activities. Public information refreshes from the existing Supabase public REST endpoint. Previously loaded text remains available offline. Media requires internet. The venue map opens only after tapping Xaritada ochish.

The information button opens About; Maxfiylik siyosati opens the in-app privacy policy. Public content is curated by the festival organiser. No Telegram installation or reviewer account is needed.
